Chapter 656 - 656 Help; Answer The Question!

Chapter 656 - 656 Help; Answer the Question!

656 Help; Answer the Question!

Dozens of people in Class 2011, including Xia Xue, saw the scene of his body being covered in shit!

Chen Ming could almost imagine how many people would laugh at him in the future.

Liu Wei seemed to feel the different atmosphere and could not help but shiver. He said nervously, “Vice President Chen, uh… If there’s nothing else, I’ll go back first.”

Chen Ming only nodded indifferently.

Liu Wei did not dare to say anything more and hurriedly turned around to leave.

Then, Chen Ming took out his phone and made a call.

“Uncle Jiahua, help me kill someone…”

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

On the first day of school, Qin Chuan only casually said a few words on the podium before starting the week-long trip to the forbidden area.

Therefore, strictly speaking…

This was the first time Lin Fan was going to class after a thousand years.

The first class was a current affairs class. It mainly explained the major events that had happened recently. The teacher systematically analyzed and explained them.

This kind of model was not bad. It allowed the students to not study too hard.

The second period was Advanced Mathematics.

Although there were some formulas added to higher mathematics, there was still not much improvement.

Lin Fan listened for a while and shook his head, looking a little disappointed.

After all, it had been a thousand years. It was a pity that mathematics, the most basic subject, had not developed much.

Standing on the podium, the teacher wearing silver-rimmed glasses. He noticed Lin Fan’s expression.

He still wanted to understand the new student’s mathematics comprehension, so he said, “Lin Fan, use what I just said to answer this question.”

The teacher with the silver-rimmed glasses casually pointed, and a 3D projection question appeared on Lin Fan’s desk.

It had to be said that with 3D projection technology, many things were indeed more convenient.

Xia Xue’s heart tightened slightly and she looked at Lin Fan worriedly.

Clearly, she was afraid that Lin Fan would not know how to answer.

Lin Fan smiled and gave her a reassuring look.

Then, he quickly wrote on the 3D projection.

d/dx[f（x）dx]=f（x)…

lim（a+c)+lim(b+c)…

Lin Fan did not even need to think about it and easily answered the question.

The teacher with silver-rimmed glasses standing on the podium nodded in satisfaction and said, “Lin Fan, your answer is not bad. It seems like you’ve already understood everything I explained…”

Lin Fan said, “Actually, this answer is a little troublesome. There are other simpler algorithms.”

“Oh?” The teacher with silver-rimmed glasses said with interest, “Explain it to me.”

Lin Fan did not hesitate and continued writing on the 3D projection.

d/dx[f（x）dx]=f（x)…

At first, the teacher with the silver-rimmed glasses had a very calm expression.

During this time, he even drank a mouthful of tea.

But gradually, he began to frown.

Even after Lin Fan used a new method to solve the question, his brows did not relax.

After a while, he said, “You used Method A for the fifth step, right?

“It’s not bad to learn extra-cursory knowledge. However, Method A hasn’t been proven yet, so it can’t be directly used as a theorem. Therefore, your algorithm is strictly wrong.

“Of course, you’re not bad either. You deserve encouragement. Continue to work hard!”

After the teacher with the silver-rimmed glasses finished speaking, he looked at Lin Fan with admiration.

“Method A? a+b..?”

“Yes.” The teacher with silver-rimmed glasses nodded.

However, his face revealed a touch of doubt.

From Lin Fan’s tone, could it be that he did not know about Method A?

Then why did he use this formula directly?

It was strange.

Lin Fan muttered, “This formula hasn’t been proven yet?”

He shook his head slightly and continued writing on the 3D projection.

a+b+c+d…

sina+cosb+…

The teacher with the silver-rimmed glasses looked at Lin Fan writing the calculations again and could not help but reveal a puzzled expression.

But soon, he seemed to have thought of something.

The teacher with the silver-rimmed glasses quickly took out a folding display screen and searched.

In the next moment, his pupils constricted slightly.

Then, he looked at Lin Fan in shock.

The students of Class 2011 looked at their teacher’s serious expression. They did not know what Lin Fan was writing.

However, they all turned their attention to Lin Fan.

Unknowingly, the atmosphere in the classroom became tense.

Suddenly, Lin Fan stopped writing.

The teacher’s pupils constricted.

He could not help but say, “This… Was it confirmed? Method A has been verified?”

He looked at the incomparably complicated 3D projection algorithm from beginning to end but realized that it was not something that he could easily verify. He hurriedly said, “Everyone, don’t move!”

Most of the time, chaos was a cause of concern.

However, the 3D projection in the classroom had already been automatically saved. What did it matter whether the students moved or not?

Then, the teacher with silver-rimmed glasses quickly made a call.

Soon, an old man with slightly white hair appeared in front of him.

“Chu Zhi, what’s the matter?” the old man asked.

“Professor Huang, are you free now?” Chu Zhi asked.

“I have to attend a meeting in ten minutes,” Professor Huang said.

“Professor Huang, someone has proven Method A.”

“Who? Where was it published?” Professor Huang hurriedly asked.

Obviously, he was very concerned about Method A.

“It hasn’t been published yet. He just wrote it down in the classroom.”

After saying that, he turned the camera.

Instantly, the proof process of Method A written by Lin Fan appeared in Professor Huang’s video.

“Chu Zhi, bring it closer!” Professor Huang quickly shouted.

“Forget it, forget it. Where are you? I’ll come over now!”

“I’m in the classroom of Class 2011,” Chu Zhi said hurriedly.

“Alright,” Professor Huang said.

Then, he hung up the phone.

A moment later, Professor Huang ran out.

A young man walked over with a stack of documents and said, “Professor Huang, I’ve prepared the materials. Shall we go to the conference room now?”

“You can attend this meeting in my place,” Professor Huang said.

“What? Then you…” The young man was surprised.

“I have more important things to do!” After Professor Huang finished speaking, he quickly ran into the distance.

…

Not long after, Professor Huang arrived at Class 2011’s classroom.

He did not even look at Chu Zhi or the students in the classroom. Instead, he focused all his attention on Method A.

He did not make any sound, as if he was worried that the sound would shatter the 3D projection.

Seeing him like this, the students could not help but become cautious. They did not even dare to make a sound when they swallowed their saliva.

About half an hour later, Professor Huang suddenly shouted excitedly, “Good, that’s great!”
